findings.description:
Reentrancy in TradeEscrow.fund(bytes32) (src/TradeEscrow.sol#99-109):
	External call allowing reentrancy:
	- token.safeTransferFrom(msg.sender,address(this),amount) (src/TradeEscrow.sol#106)
	Balance read before the call:
	- beforeBalance = token.balanceOf(address(this)) (src/TradeEscrow.sol#105)
	Possible stale balance used after the call in a condition:
	- token.balanceOf(address(this)) - beforeBalance != amount (src/TradeEscrow.sol#107)
		- stale variable `beforeBalance`

TradeEscrow.constructor(TradeEscrow.Terms) (src/TradeEscrow.sol#71-85) uses timestamp for comparisons
	Dangerous comparisons:
	- t.fundBy <= block.timestamp || t.fundBy > block.timestamp + 604800 || t.dispatchWindow < 86400 || t.dispatchWindow > 2592000 || t.deliveryWindow < 86400 || t.deliveryWindow > 5184000 || (t.inspectionWindow != 86400 && t.inspectionWindow != 172800 && t.inspectionWindow != 259200) (src/TradeEscrow.sol#73)

TradeEscrow.openDispute(bytes32) (src/TradeEscrow.sol#146-160) uses timestamp for comparisons
	Dangerous comparisons:
	- state == State.Inspecting && block.timestamp >= inspectUntil (src/TradeEscrow.sol#151)
	- block.timestamp < deliveryBy (src/TradeEscrow.sol#155)

TradeEscrow.acceptTerms(bytes32) (src/TradeEscrow.sol#86-92) uses timestamp for comparisons
	Dangerous comparisons:
	- block.timestamp >= fundBy (src/TradeEscrow.sol#88)

TradeEscrow.releaseAfterInspection() (src/TradeEscrow.sol#131-135) uses timestamp for comparisons
	Dangerous comparisons:
	- block.timestamp < inspectUntil (src/TradeEscrow.sol#133)

TradeEscrow.fund(bytes32) (src/TradeEscrow.sol#99-109) uses timestamp for comparisons
	Dangerous comparisons:
	- block.timestamp >= fundBy (src/TradeEscrow.sol#101)

TradeEscrow.refundUndispatched() (src/TradeEscrow.sol#136-140) uses timestamp for comparisons
	Dangerous comparisons:
	- block.timestamp < dispatchBy (src/TradeEscrow.sol#138)

TradeEscrow.markDispatched(bytes32) (src/TradeEscrow.sol#111-119) uses timestamp for comparisons
	Dangerous comparisons:
	- block.timestamp >= dispatchBy (src/TradeEscrow.sol#113)
